items.title: File Einspruch against tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielau ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Thu 19.11.2026; no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is given, so posting day = 19.11.2026. Tax office (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO): delivery deemed on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days: 20.11.(day1,Fri), 21.11.(day2,Sat), 22.11.(day3,Sun), 23.11.(day4,Mon) → deemed delivery 23.11.2026 (Monday, not a weekend/holiday, so no shift under §108 Abs.3 AO). One-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO runs per §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §187/§188 BGB: delivery day (23.11.) is the triggering event and is not counted itself; the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday) — not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO.
